# support feature/XYZ-123, bugfix/, etc for git flow

Let the git flow create branches with the type prefixes that Bitbucket and Jira expect — `feature/XYZ-123-…`, `bugfix/…`, `hotfix/…` — instead of the bare `XYZ-123-…` that [git_start](../../bin/git_start) produces (the attached screenshot showed Bitbucket's branch-type selector). Team tooling keys automation and permissions off the prefix, so a branch without it is second-class on the server even if the commits are fine.
